annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: Follow the maintenance reminder or owner's manual; often 5,000–7,500 miles, sooner with hard driving
maint.note: On 2017-2021 cars, dealers can charge far more because more fluids are serviced.

maint.every: About every 25,000–50,000 miles, depending on driving
maint.note: Optional carbon-ceramic brakes on 2017-2021 cars cost much more.

maint.every: About every 3–5 years; use a battery maintainer if the car sits
maint.note: A weak 12V battery on 2017-2021 cars can trigger warnings and door handle glitches.

maint.every: Done with the timing belt service on 1996-2005 cars; about 120,000 km (75,000 miles) on 2017-2021 cars
maint.note: On 2017-2021 cars the job is labor-heavy and is often done with other major service work.

maint.every: When the maintenance reminder calls for it (about every 5 years or with the timing belt service)
maint.note: The long coolant hoses in this mid-engine car make bleeding air out important.
